title: The spared tissue is abnormal and disconnected

statements.text: Imaging shows the remaining patches in the left anterior insula and cingulate are abnormal and largely disconnected, about 10 percent of insula and 1 percent of cingulate tissue remain, and the patient lost heartbeat awareness under isoproterenol when skin pathways were anesthetized.

sources.quote: are highly abnormal and have been largely disconnected (both anatomically and functionally) from the rest of the brain
only 10% of tissue remaining in his insula and 1% of tissue remaining in his ACC
